label: Limit orders and TWAMM
summary: Model price-triggered and long-term orders with explicit escrow, execution, cancellation and liveness rules.
requiredFacts: Order owner, input escrow, price or time condition, expiry, partial fill, cancellation and proceeds claim
TWAMM interval, virtual execution schedule, rate updates and treatment of missed intervals
Tick, price, rounding and fee basis for every execution direction
Keeper permissions, incentives, censorship resistance and permissionless liveness fallback
Per-pool and per-order accounting keys, maximum active state and cleanup behavior
requiredTests: Create, fill, partial fill, cancel, expire and claim across both currency directions
Independent-model comparison for virtual execution, intervals, rates, fees and rounding
Missed, duplicated, reordered and censored keeper execution
Price crossing, tick boundary, zero amount, dust and maximum active-order cases
Escrow solvency, pool isolation, reentrancy and state-cleanup invariants
risks: Escrow or virtual-order accounting errors can create insolvency across many orders
Keeper timing can become a censorship or value-extraction surface
Unbounded order state can make execution or cleanup unavailable
